name: Example table: green roof systems
description: Three green roof systems: the share of a year's rain each holds back, how much cooler it keeps the roof, and its cost per m2. One of nine example tables that illustrate ways to chart a comparison of scenarios, each row's scenario in its case column. The Nine ways to chart scenario comparisons test dataflow draws it as a table. Curio's seeded script scripts/build_example_scenario_charts.py writes it.
